claim: IL-2 amounts in T cell culture supernatants were reduced upon blockade of CD80 and CD86 at lower peptide concentrations.
source: In the restimulation of in vitro primed 5C.C7 T cells with CH27 B cell lymphoma APCs and MCC peptide IL-2 amounts in the supernatant were reduced upon blockade of the CD28 ligands CD80 and CD86 ('costimulation blockade') and in T cells from Itk knock out 5C.C7 TCR transgenic mice, in particular at lower peptide concentrations (Figure 1A).
evidence: The claim is supported by experimental data shown in Figure 1A measuring IL-2 levels in supernatants under different conditions.

claim: IL-2 mRNA levels in T cells were significantly reduced to less than 50% upon costimulation blockade and Itk-deficiency at 10 µM MCC peptide concentration.
source: Even at an MCC peptide concentration of 10 µM the level of IL-2 mRNA in T cells was significantly (p<0.001) reduced to less than 50% upon costimulation blockade and Itk-deficiency (Figure 1B).
evidence: The claim is supported by experimental measurements of IL-2 mRNA levels with statistical significance indicated (p<0.001).

claim: IL-2 mRNA generation occurred during the first six hours of T cell activation.
source: IL-2 mRNA generation occurred during the first six hours of T cell activation, consistent with transient nuclear localization of NFkB and previous data establishing that APC contact times of less than one hour are sufficient to commit a primed T cells to proliferation (Iezzi et al., 1998).
evidence: The claim is supported by experimental time course data and is consistent with cited previous work.

claim: APC contact times of less than one hour are sufficient to commit a primed T cell to proliferation.
source: IL-2 mRNA generation occurred during the first six hours of T cell activation, consistent with transient nuclear localization of NFkB and previous data establishing that APC contact times of less than one hour are sufficient to commit a primed T cells to proliferation (Iezzi et al., 1998).
evidence: The claim is supported by citation to previous work by Iezzi et al., 1998.

claim: Upon costimulation blockade, most sensors that displayed frequent central accumulation upon full T cell stimulation during the first two minutes of cell coupling did less so.
source: Upon costimulation blockade most sensors that displayed frequent central accumulation upon full T cell stimulation, in particular during the first two minutes of cell coupling, did less so.
evidence: The claim is supported by imaging data showing patterns of sensor localization under different conditions.

claim: In Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells, sensors with only transient early central accumulation in wild type T cells lost much of that accumulation.
source: In Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells sensors with only transient early central accumulation in wild type T cells lost much of that accumulation (Figure 1C,D; Figure 1—figure supplements 2B–4, Figure 1—source data 1).
evidence: The claim is supported by imaging data comparing sensor localization in wild type versus Itk-deficient T cells.

claim: Reduced central accumulation upon costimulation blockade and Itk-deficiency is indicative of reduced cSMAC formation.
source: Both phenotypes are indicative of reduced cSMAC formation.
evidence: The claim is an interpretation based on observed patterns of protein localization.

claim: Efficient IL-2 secretion was associated with µm scale central signaling localization.
source: Efficient IL-2 secretion thus was associated with µm scale central signaling localization.
evidence: The claim is an inference drawn from the correlation between central protein accumulation and IL-2 production across different conditions.

claim: LAT displayed µm scale central localization in a biphasic pattern.
source: LAT as a key cSMAC component displayed µm scale central localization (Figure 2A) in a biphasic pattern.
evidence: The claim is supported by imaging data showing LAT localization over time.

claim: At the time of tight cell coupling under full stimulus conditions, 49 ± 6% of cell couples showed central LAT accumulation.
source: At the time of tight cell coupling under full stimulus conditions 49 ± 6% of cell couples showed central LAT accumulation.
evidence: The claim is supported by quantitative analysis of imaging data.

claim: After 2 min of cell coupling, central LAT accumulation was only found in about 25% of cell couples and remained stable at that level.
source: After 2 min of cell coupling central LAT accumulation was only found in about 25% of cell couples (Figure 2B) and remained stable at that level.
evidence: The claim is supported by quantitative analysis of imaging data over time.

claim: In the absence of Itk, the initial peak of central LAT accumulation was significantly diminished to 26 ± 6% of cell couples.
source: In the absence of Itk, the initial peak of central LAT accumulation was significantly (p=0.005) diminished to 26 ± 6% of cell couples with central LAT accumulation.
evidence: The claim is supported by quantitative imaging data with statistical significance indicated.

claim: Upon costimulation blockade, central LAT accumulation was reduced to 11 ± 4%.
source: Such reduction was more pronounced (11 ± 4%, p<0.001) upon costimulation blockade (Figure 2B; Figure 2—source data 1).
evidence: The claim is supported by quantitative imaging data with statistical significance indicated.

claim: Combining costimulation blockade and Itk deficiency yielded the least interface LAT accumulation.
source: Combining costimulation blockade and Itk deficiency yielded the least interface LAT accumulation (Figure 2B).
evidence: The claim is supported by imaging data comparing different experimental conditions.

claim: Impaired activation of cytoskeletal transport processes is a likely contributor to diminished central LAT accumulation upon costimulation blockade and Itk deficiency.
source: Impaired activation of cytoskeletal transport processes is a likely contributor to diminished central LAT accumulation upon costimulation blockade and Itk deficiency, as enhancement of actin dynamics with active Rac and Cofilin (Roybal et al., 2016) significantly (p<0.001, Figure 2C; Figure 2—source data 1)(Roybal et al., 2016) increased central and overall LAT accumulation.
evidence: The claim is an inference supported by experimental data showing that enhancing actin dynamics increases LAT accumulation, and is consistent with cited previous work.

claim: Enhancement of actin dynamics with active Rac and Cofilin significantly increased central and overall LAT accumulation.
source: Impaired activation of cytoskeletal transport processes is a likely contributor to diminished central LAT accumulation upon costimulation blockade and Itk deficiency, as enhancement of actin dynamics with active Rac and Cofilin (Roybal et al., 2016) significantly (p<0.001, Figure 2C; Figure 2—source data 1)(Roybal et al., 2016) increased central and overall LAT accumulation.
evidence: The claim is supported by experimental data with statistical significance indicated.

claim: Attenuation of T cell activation was associated with diminished LAT phosphorylation at Y191 upon costimulation blockade, particularly in combination with Itk deficiency.
source: Attenuation of T cell activation was associated with diminished LAT phosphorylation at Y191 (Figure 2D; Figure 2—source data 1) upon costimulation blockade, in particular in combination with Itk deficiency.
evidence: The claim is supported by Western blot data measuring LAT phosphorylation.

claim: At 2, 5, and 10 min after tight cell coupling, LAT phosphorylation was significantly reduced in Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells upon costimulation blockade compared to wild type 5C.C7 T cells under full stimulus conditions by 39%, 61%, and 70%, respectively.
source: At 2, 5, and 10 min after tight cell coupling LAT phosphorylation was significantly (p≤0.02) reduced in Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells upon costimulation blockade compared to wild type 5C.C7 T cells under full stimulus conditions by 39%, 61%, and 70%, respectively.
evidence: The claim is supported by quantitative Western blot data with statistical significance indicated.

claim: Multiple LAT/pLAT complexes formed in the cSMAC and/or beyond, on average four per cell.
source: Multiple LAT/pLAT complexes formed in the cSMAC and/or beyond, on average four per cell.
evidence: The claim is supported by STED super-resolution microscopy data.

claim: LAT complexes were significantly larger in the cSMAC region with a supramolecular volume of 0.23 ± 0.03 µm3 than in T cells without a cSMAC (0.12 ± 0.01 µm3).
source: LAT complexes were significantly larger (p=0.04) in the cSMAC region with a supramolecular volume of 0.23 ± 0.03 µm3 than in T cells without a cSMAC (0.12 ± 0.01 µm3)(Figure 3B).
evidence: The claim is supported by quantitative STED microscopy data with statistical significance indicated.

claim: pLAT complexes were larger in the cSMAC region with volumes of 0.25 ± 0.03 µm3 compared to 0.13 ± 0.01 µm3 in non-cSMAC regions.
source: pLAT complexes were similarly larger in the cSMAC region with volumes of 0.25 ± 0.03 µm3 (cSMAC) versus 0.13 ± 0.01 µm3 (non-cSMAC, p=0.007)(Figure 3B).
evidence: The claim is supported by quantitative STED microscopy data with statistical significance indicated.

claim: The ratio of plasma membrane length to straight-line diameter was significantly larger in the cSMAC (2.2 ± 0.3) than in the pSMAC of the same T cell (1.4 ± 0.1).
source: This ratio was significantly (p<0.001) larger in the cSMAC (2.2 ± 0.3) than in the pSMAC of the same T cell (1.4 ± 0.1).
evidence: The claim is supported by quantitative electron microscopy measurements with statistical significance indicated.

claim: In control cell couples without cSMAC formation, the membrane undulation ratio measured across the entire interface was 1.5 ± 0.1, as small as that in pSMAC regions of cell couples with central LAT clustering.
source: In control cell couples without cSMAC formation the ratio as measured across the entire interface was as small (1.5 ± 0.1) as that in pSMAC regions of cell couples with central LAT clustering (Figure 3D).
evidence: The claim is supported by quantitative electron microscopy measurements.

claim: The cSMAC is a cellular region where membrane undulations and multiple supramolecular complexes are associated with enhanced proximity of signaling intermediates.
source: The cSMAC thus is a cellular region where membrane undulations and multiple supramolecular complexes are associated with enhanced proximity of signaling intermediates.
evidence: The claim is an inference drawn from the structural characterization of the cSMAC.

claim: The PKCθ V3 domain is required for central interface accumulation of PKCθ.
source: The PKCθ V3 domain is required for central interface accumulation of PKCθ (Kong et al., 2011) even though it couldn't drive central localization by itself (Figure 4—figure supplement 1A).
evidence: The claim is supported by citation to previous work and imaging data showing the V3 domain alone does not localize centrally.

claim: The PKCθ V3 domain couldn't drive central localization by itself.
source: The PKCθ V3 domain is required for central interface accumulation of PKCθ (Kong et al., 2011) even though it couldn't drive central localization by itself (Figure 4—figure supplement 1A).
evidence: The claim is supported by imaging data showing localization patterns of the isolated V3 domain.

claim: The Vav1 SH3SH2SH3 domains drove strong central accumulation only within the first minute of cell coupling.
source: The Vav1 SH3SH2SH3 domains drove strong central accumulation only within the first minute of cell coupling (Figure 4—figure supplement 1A), as consistent with the localization of full length Vav1 (Figure 1—figure supplement 2A).
evidence: The claim is supported by imaging data showing temporal localization patterns.

claim: The PLCδ PH domain mediated interface accumulation focused on the first two minutes of cell coupling without a central preference.
source: The PLCδ PH domain mediated interface accumulation focused on the first two minutes of cell coupling without a central preference (Figure 4—figure supplement 1A).
evidence: The claim is supported by imaging data showing localization patterns.

claim: GFP fusion proteins were expressed at 2.1 ± 0.7 fold the endogenous level of LAT in non-transduced T cells.
source: GFP fusion proteins were expressed at 2.1 ± 0.7 fold the endogenous level of LAT in non-transduced T cells (Figure 4—figure supplement 1B,C) with little change to endogenous LAT levels in the transduced T cells.
evidence: The claim is supported by Western blot quantification data.

claim: Fusion of LAT to the PKCθ V3 domain yielded efficient central accumulation that was well sustained over the entire imaging time frame under all conditions at levels around 50% of cell couples with central accumulation.
source: Fusion of LAT to the PKCθ V3 domain (LAT V3) yielded efficient central accumulation that was well sustained over the entire imaging time frame under all conditions at levels around 50% of cell couples with central accumulation (Figure 4).
evidence: The claim is supported by imaging data showing LAT V3 localization patterns.

claim: Starting 40 s after tight cell coupling, sustained central accumulation of LAT V3 was significantly more frequent than central accumulation of non-targeted LAT under full stimulus at almost every time point.
source: Starting 40 s after tight cell coupling such sustained central accumulation was significantly (p<0.05, Figure 4—source data 1) more frequent than central accumulation of non-targeted LAT under full stimulus at almost every time point.
evidence: The claim is supported by quantitative imaging data with statistical significance indicated.

claim: Fusion of LAT to the PKCθ V3 domain stabilized central LAT accumulation well beyond the levels seen for LAT alone under any physiological condition.
source: Fusion of LAT to the PKCθ V3 domain thus stabilized central LAT accumulation well beyond the levels seen for LAT alone under any physiological condition.
evidence: The claim is an inference drawn from the comparison of LAT V3 and LAT localization patterns.

claim: In cSMACs formed upon LAT V3 expression, membrane undulations were similarly enhanced as in T cells expressing LAT.
source: Nevertheless, in cSMACs formed upon LAT V3 expression membrane undulations were similarly enhanced as in T cells expressing LAT (Figure 3D) supporting comparable cSMAC properties.
evidence: The claim is supported by electron microscopy measurements of membrane undulations.

claim: Fusion of LAT with the Vav1 SH3SH2SH3 domains resulted in diminished central and overall accumulation compared to LAT alone upon a full T cell stimulus.
source: Upon a full T cell stimulus LAT Vav resulted in diminished central and overall accumulation compared to LAT alone that was significant (p<0.05) across many time points (Figure 4; Figure 4—source data 1), suggesting that LAT Vav does not enhance properly assembled signaling complexes.
evidence: The claim is supported by imaging data with statistical significance indicated.

claim: LAT Vav does not enhance properly assembled signaling complexes upon full T cell stimulus.
source: Upon a full T cell stimulus LAT Vav resulted in diminished central and overall accumulation compared to LAT alone that was significant (p<0.05) across many time points (Figure 4; Figure 4—source data 1), suggesting that LAT Vav does not enhance properly assembled signaling complexes.
evidence: The claim is an inference based on the observation that LAT Vav shows diminished accumulation under full stimulus conditions.

claim: Upon the three attenuated stimuli, LAT Vav consistently enhanced central accumulation, most dramatically for costimulation blockade in wild type and Itk deficient cells.
source: Upon the three attenuated stimuli LAT Vav consistently enhanced central accumulation, most dramatically (p≤0.001, at most time points) for costimulation blockade in wild type and Itk deficient cells (Figure 4; Figure 4—source data 1).
evidence: The claim is supported by imaging data with statistical significance indicated.

claim: LAT Vav accumulation upon attenuated T cell stimulation in any pattern was largely indistinguishable from non-targeted LAT accumulation under full stimulus conditions.
source: LAT Vav accumulation upon attenuated T cell stimulation in any pattern was largely indistinguishable from non-targeted LAT accumulation under full stimulus conditions (p>0.05, Figure 4—source data 1) and central accumulation was moderately enhanced only between 1 and 3 min after tight cell coupling.
evidence: The claim is supported by statistical comparison of imaging data.

claim: Fusion of LAT to the Vav1 SH3SH2SH3 domain allowed for fairly close reconstitution of full stimulus-type LAT localization upon attenuated T cell stimulation.
source: Fusion of LAT to the Vav1 SH3SH2SH3 domain thus allowed for fairly close reconstitution of full stimulus-type LAT localization upon attenuated T cell stimulation.
evidence: The claim is an inference drawn from the comparison of LAT Vav localization under attenuated conditions to LAT localization under full stimulus.

claim: Fusion of LAT to the PLCδ PH domain resembled LAT Vav but was less powerful.
source: Fusion of LAT to the PLCδ PH domain ('LAT PLCδPH') resembled LAT Vav but was less powerful (Figure 4; Figure 4—source data 1).
evidence: The claim is supported by comparison of imaging data for LAT PLCδPH and LAT Vav.

claim: Upon the three attenuated T cell stimuli, LAT PLCδPH moderately enhanced central and overall LAT accumulation but didn't consistently reach the same extent as LAT alone under full stimulus conditions.
source: Upon the three attenuated T cell stimuli LAT PLCδPH moderately enhanced central and overall LAT accumulation but didn't consistently reach the same extent as LAT alone under full stimulus conditions.
evidence: The claim is supported by imaging data comparing LAT PLCδPH under attenuated conditions to LAT under full stimulus.

claim: In Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells upon costimulation blockade, interface accumulation in any pattern was consistently enhanced from <32% to >55% upon expression of LAT PLCδPH.
source: For example, in Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells upon costimulation blockade interface accumulation in any pattern was consistently enhanced (p<0.005 for time point 20 and later) from <32% to>55% upon expression of LAT PLCδPH.
evidence: The claim is supported by quantitative imaging data with statistical significance indicated.

claim: All LAT constructs showed substantial interface recruitment with moderately less LAT Vav recruitment at the last four time points.
source: All constructs showed substantial interface recruitment with moderately less LAT Vav recruitment at the last four time points (Figure 4—figure supplement 1D,E).
evidence: The claim is supported by computational quantification of interface enrichment.

claim: The targeted LAT constructs were tyrosine phosphorylated upon T cell activation.
source: To ensure functionality of the targeted LAT constructs, we showed that they were tyrosine phosphorylated upon T cell activation (Figure 4—figure supplement 1F).
evidence: The claim is supported by Western blot data showing phosphorylation.

claim: Fusion of LAT with additional protein interaction domains allowed control of central clustering.
source: Fusion of LAT with additional protein interaction domains thus allowed us to control central clustering: Fusion with the PKCθ V3 domain yielded consistently enhanced central localization, fusion with the Vav1 SH3SH2SH3 domains largely restored full stimulus-type LAT localization upon costimulation blockade and Itk deficiency and fusion with the PLCδ PH domain resulted in partial restoration.
evidence: The claim is a summary inference based on the imaging data for all three LAT fusion constructs.

claim: Expression of the targeting domains in isolation had only minor effects on IL-2 mRNA amounts.
source: Expression of the targeting domains in isolation had only minor effects on IL-2 mRNA amounts (Figure 5—figure supplement 1).
evidence: The claim is supported by IL-2 mRNA measurement data.

claim: Forcing exaggerated central LAT clustering by fusion with the PKCθ V3 domain did not affect IL-2 mRNA amounts.
source: Forcing exaggerated central LAT clustering by fusion with the PKCθ V3 domain did not affect IL-2 mRNA amounts (Figure 5A,B) as further discussed below.
evidence: The claim is supported by IL-2 mRNA measurement data.

claim: Restoring LAT centrality under costimulation blocked and Itk deficient conditions to slightly higher (LAT Vav) or slightly lower (LAT PLCδPH) levels than seen for non-targeted LAT under full stimulus conditions yielded a consistent and largely significant increase in IL-2 mRNA.
source: In contrast, restoring LAT centrality under costimulation blocked and Itk deficient conditions to slightly higher (LAT Vav) or slightly lower (LAT PLCδPH) levels than seen for non-targeted LAT under full stimulus conditions yielded a consistent and largely significant (p<0.05) increase in IL-2 mRNA (Figure 5A,B) to levels close to the amounts of IL-2 mRNA in LAT-transduced 5C.C7 T cells under full stimulus conditions.
evidence: The claim is supported by IL-2 mRNA measurement data with statistical significance indicated.

claim: In LAT-expressing 5C.C7 T cells, IL-2 mRNA amounts dropped to 18 ± 6% and 18 ± 3% of full stimulus mRNA upon costimulation blockade in wild type and Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells, respectively.
source: For example, in LAT-expressing 5C.C7 T cells IL-2 mRNA amounts dropped to 18 ± 6% and 18 ± 3% of full stimulus mRNA upon costimulation blockade in wild type and Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells, respectively.
evidence: The claim is supported by IL-2 mRNA measurement data.

claim: Expression of LAT Vav restored IL-2 mRNA to 41 ± 9% and 58 ± 10% in wild type and Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells upon costimulation blockade, respectively.
source: Expression of LAT Vav restored IL-2 mRNA to 41 ± 9% and 58 ± 10% (p<0.01), respectively, and expression of LAT PLCδPH to 50 ± 9% (p<0.05) and 88 ± 23%.
evidence: The claim is supported by IL-2 mRNA measurement data with statistical significance indicated.

claim: Expression of LAT PLCδPH restored IL-2 mRNA to 50 ± 9% and 88 ± 23% in wild type and Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells upon costimulation blockade, respectively.
source: Expression of LAT Vav restored IL-2 mRNA to 41 ± 9% and 58 ± 10% (p<0.01), respectively, and expression of LAT PLCδPH to 50 ± 9% (p<0.05) and 88 ± 23%.
evidence: The claim is supported by IL-2 mRNA measurement data with statistical significance indicated.

claim: µm scale central LAT interface accumulation supported efficient IL-2 secretion depending on accumulation extent and dynamics.
source: µm scale central LAT interface accumulation thus supported efficient IL-2 secretion depending on accumulation extent and dynamics.
evidence: The claim is an inference drawn from the correlation between LAT localization patterns and IL-2 production.

claim: Expression of LAT V3 moderately diminished interface recruitment of Grb2, Lck and Vav1 under full stimulus conditions.
source: Under full stimulus conditions expression of LAT V3 moderately diminished interface recruitment of Grb2, Lck and Vav1 (Figure 6; Figure 6—source data 1) suggesting that excessive central LAT localization upsets a finely balanced signaling system.
evidence: The claim is supported by imaging data showing localization of other signaling intermediates in the presence of LAT V3.

claim: Excessive central LAT localization upsets a finely balanced signaling system.
source: Under full stimulus conditions expression of LAT V3 moderately diminished interface recruitment of Grb2, Lck and Vav1 (Figure 6; Figure 6—source data 1) suggesting that excessive central LAT localization upsets a finely balanced signaling system.
evidence: The claim is an inference based on the observation that LAT V3 diminishes recruitment of other signaling intermediates.

claim: Upon costimulation blockade, the localization of Grb2, Lck and Vav1 was largely unaffected by LAT V3.
source: Upon costimulation blockade the localization of all three signaling intermediates was largely unaffected by LAT V3.
evidence: The claim is supported by imaging data comparing localization with and without LAT V3.

claim: Grb2 and Lck centrality was moderately enhanced in Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells upon LAT V3 expression.
source: Grb2 and Lck centrality was moderately enhanced in Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells.
evidence: The claim is supported by imaging data showing localization patterns.

claim: While the percentage of Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells with central Grb2-GFP expression did not exceed 7% at 40 s after cell coupling and thereafter, upon co-expression of LAT V3 this percentage averaged 15% over the same time frame.
source: For example, while the percentage of Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells with central Grb2-GFP expression did not exceed 7% at 40 s after cell coupling and thereafter, upon co-expression of LAT V3 this percentage averaged 15% over the same time frame.
evidence: The claim is supported by quantitative imaging data.

claim: The moderate enhancement of Grb2 and Lck centrality by LAT V3 in Itk-deficient cells did not occur at the time of tight cell coupling but was restricted to later time points.
source: Such moderate enhancement did not occur at the time of tight cell coupling but was restricted to later time points.
evidence: The claim is supported by temporal analysis of imaging data.

claim: In Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells upon costimulation blockade, Grb2 accumulation was substantially enhanced upon parallel expression of LAT V3, reaching levels of central Grb2 accumulation not seen under any other experimental condition investigated.
source: In Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells upon costimulation blockade, however, Grb2 accumulation was substantially enhanced upon parallel expression of LAT V3, reaching levels of central Grb2 accumulation not seen under any other experimental condition investigated.
evidence: The claim is supported by imaging data comparing Grb2 localization across conditions.

claim: The centrality of Vav1 was not altered under any condition by LAT V3 expression.
source: The centrality of Vav1 as a signaling intermediate with only minor early central accumulation (Figure 1—figure supplement 2B) was not altered under any condition.
evidence: The claim is supported by imaging data showing Vav1 localization.

claim: The forced central localization of LAT could only draw in Grb2 and Lck as signaling intermediates with some intrinsic central localization preference to a mostly moderate extent and upon only some attenuated T cell stimuli.
source: The forced central localization of LAT thus could only draw in Grb2 and Lck as signaling intermediates with some intrinsic central localization preference to a mostly moderate extent and upon only some attenuated T cell stimuli.
evidence: The claim is an inference drawn from the imaging data showing limited recruitment of other signaling intermediates by LAT V3.

claim: At the time of tight cell coupling under full stimulus conditions, 45 ± 7% of the cell couples displayed SLP-76 accumulation at the interface center.
source: At the time of tight cell coupling under full stimulus conditions 45 ± 7% of the cell couples displayed SLP-76 accumulation at the interface center, similar to LAT.
evidence: The claim is supported by quantitative imaging data.

claim: 80 s after tight cell coupling, the percentage of cell couples with central SLP-76 accumulation dropped to less than 10%.
source: However, 80 s later this percentage dropped to less than 10% (Figure 7A,B).
evidence: The claim is supported by quantitative imaging data.

claim: The peak of central SLP-76 accumulation was significantly diminished upon costimulation blockade, Itk-deficiency and the combination of both to <27%, <15% and <11% of cell couples with central SLP-76 accumulation, respectively.
source: Also similar to LAT, the peak of central SLP-76 accumulation was significantly (p≤0.01) diminished upon costimulation blockade, Itk-deficiency and the combination of both to <27%,<15% and<11% of cell couples with central SLP-76 accumulation, respectively (Figure 7B; Figure 7—source data 1).
evidence: The claim is supported by quantitative imaging data with statistical significance indicated.

claim: Both SLP-76 fusion constructs did not significantly affect SLP-76 centrality under full stimulus conditions, in wild type or Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells.
source: Both SLP-76 fusion constructs did not significantly affect SLP-76 centrality under full stimulus conditions, in wild type or Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells (Figure 7B; Figure 7—source data 1).
evidence: The claim is supported by statistical analysis of imaging data.

claim: Accumulation of SLP-76 at the interface center was moderately but significantly enhanced upon costimulation blockade in wild type and Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells by SLP-76 V3 and SLP-76 Vav.
source: However, accumulation of SLP-76 at the interface center was moderately but significantly (p<0.05 at at least two time points within the first minute of tight cell coupling, the peak of central SLP-76 accumulation) enhanced upon costimulation blockade in wild type and Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells reaching for example 67 ± 7% and 33 ± 7%, respectively, of cell couples with central SLP-76 accumulation upon expression of SLP-76 Vav (Figure 7B; Figure 7—source data 1).
evidence: The claim is supported by quantitative imaging data with statistical significance indicated.

claim: The enhancement of SLP-76 centrality was limited to the first minute of tight cell coupling, the time where non-targeted SLP-76 accumulated at the interface center.
source: Interestingly, the enhancement of SLP-76 centrality was limited to the first minute of tight cell coupling, the time where non-targeted SLP-76 accumulated at the interface center.
evidence: The claim is supported by temporal analysis of imaging data.

claim: Expression of SLP-76 V3 and SLP-76 Vav resulted in a modest increase in IL-2 mRNA amounts under costimulation blocked conditions.
source: Consistent with the enhancement of SLP-76 centrality we observed a modest increase in IL-2 mRNA amounts under costimulation blocked conditions upon expression of SLP-76 V3 and SLP-76 Vav.
evidence: The claim is supported by IL-2 mRNA measurement data.

claim: Upon expression of non-targeted SLP-76, costimulation blockade in wild type and Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells reduced IL-2 mRNA amounts to 45 ± 9% and 21 ± 1%, respectively, of full stimulus.
source: Upon expression of non-targeted SLP-76 costimulation blockade in wild type and Itk-deficient 5C.C7 T cells reduced IL-2 mRNA amounts to 45 ± 9% and 21 ± 1%, respectively, of full stimulus (Figure 7C).
evidence: The claim is supported by IL-2 mRNA measurement data.

claim: Expression of SLP-76 V3 restored IL-2 mRNA amounts to 87 ± 20% and 74 ± 24% in wild type and Itk-deficient cells upon costimulation blockade, respectively.
source: Expression of SLP-76 V3 restored IL-2 mRNA amounts to 87 ± 20% and 74 ± 24%, respectively, expression of SLP-76 Vav to 73 ± 8% and 75 ± 30% without reaching statistical significance in the stringent 2-way ANOVA (Figure 7C).
evidence: The claim is supported by IL-2 mRNA measurement data.

claim: Expression of SLP-76 Vav restored IL-2 mRNA amounts to 73 ± 8% and 75 ± 30% in wild type and Itk-deficient cells upon costimulation blockade, respectively.
source: Expression of SLP-76 V3 restored IL-2 mRNA amounts to 87 ± 20% and 74 ± 24%, respectively, expression of SLP-76 Vav to 73 ± 8% and 75 ± 30% without reaching statistical significance in the stringent 2-way ANOVA (Figure 7C).
evidence: The claim is supported by IL-2 mRNA measurement data.

claim: Enhancement of centrality and IL-2 secretion remained closely linked across multiple T cell activation conditions and spatially targeted SLP-76 constructs.
source: Importantly, enhancement of centrality and IL-2 secretion remained closely linked across multiple T cell activation conditions and spatially targeted SLP-76 constructs (Figure 5B) thus corroborating the importance of µm scale central protein accumulation within the first two minutes of cell coupling for IL-2 secretion.
evidence: The claim is an inference drawn from the correlation between SLP-76 localization and IL-2 production.

claim: Upon 5C.C7 T cell activation with a full stimulus, Grb2 is efficiently recruited to the T cell:APC interface during the first two minutes of tight cell coupling, peaking at 80 ± 5% of cell couples with any interface accumulation.
source: Upon 5C.C7 T cell activation with a full stimulus Grb2 is efficiently recruited to the T cell:APC interface during the first two minutes of tight cell coupling, peaking at 80 ± 5% of cell couples with any interface accumulation.
evidence: The claim is supported by quantitative imaging data.

claim: Overall Grb2 interface accumulation was significantly diminished upon costimulation blockade, Itk-deficiency and both, remaining below 64%, 35% and 43%, respectively of cell couples with any interface accumulation.
source: This overall interface accumulation was significantly (p≤0.02 at at least three time points within the first two minutes of tight cell coupling) diminished upon costimulation blockade, Itk-deficiency and both, remaining below 64%, 35% and 43%, respectively of cell couples with any interface accumulation (Figure 8A,B; Figure 8—source data 1).
evidence: The claim is supported by quantitative imaging data with statistical significance indicated.

claim: Grb2 accumulation at the interface center didn't exceed 20% under any of the T cell activation conditions.
source: Distinguishing Grb2 from LAT and SLP-76, Grb2 accumulation at the interface center didn't exceed 20% under any of the T cell activation conditions.
evidence: The claim is supported by quantitative imaging data.

claim: Fusion of Grb2 with PKCθ V3 or Vav1 SH3SH2SH3 did not enhance centrality under any of the T cell activation conditions.
source: Fusion of Grb2 with PKCθ V3 ('Grb2 V3') or Vav1 SH3SH2SH3 ('Grb2 Vav') did not enhance centrality under any of the T cell activation conditions (Figure 8B, Figure 8—source data 1).
evidence: The claim is supported by imaging data showing Grb2 fusion protein localization.

claim: Fusion with the PKCθ V3 domain did not substantially alter Grb2 localization at all.
source: Fusion with the PKCθ V3 domain did not substantially alter Grb2 localization at all (Figure 8B).
evidence: The claim is supported by imaging data.

claim: Fusion with the Vav1 SH3SH2SH3 domain enhanced overall Grb2 interface recruitment across many time points under all T cell activation conditions.
source: Fusion with the Vav1 SH3SH2SH3 domain enhanced overall Grb2 interface recruitment across many time points under all T cell activation conditions (Figure 8B).
evidence: The claim is supported by imaging data.

claim: Most of the Grb2 Vav accumulation was in the peripheral pattern, a pattern common with full length Vav1.
source: However, most of this accumulation was in the peripheral pattern, a pattern common with full length Vav1 (Figure 1—figure supplement 2B).
evidence: The claim is supported by imaging data showing localization patterns.

claim: A protein with a minor intrinsic central preference cannot be forced to the interface center.
source: As an important negative control, a protein with a minor intrinsic central preference can thus not be forced to the interface center.
evidence: The claim is an inference drawn from the failure of Grb2 fusion proteins to localize centrally.

claim: Expression of Grb2 V3 or Grb2 Vav did not alter IL-2 mRNA production under any of the T cell activation conditions.
